rows.label: Bhakoot
rows.note: Scorpio 2/12 Sagittarius; bhakoot dosha cancelled: rashi lords Mars and Jupiter are mutual natural friends

manglik.note: You are both Manglik. Tradition says the two balance each other, so this is not a concern for the match.

observance_note: Traditions differ on some koota rules: Vashya, the in-between Yoni grades, and when a Nadi or Bhakoot dosha counts as cancelled. Another astrologer may score this pair a little differently.
notes: Varna and Vashya are read from the first person's side, the groom's in marriage matching, so swapping the two people can change those rows.

strengths.line: You look at duty and work in a similar way.
strengths.why: Varna 1 of 1 (Brahmin (groom's side) with Kshatriya). Varna groups each Moon sign by its outlook on work and duty.

strengths.line: Your minds understand each other. Lean on this when you talk about harder things.
strengths.why: Graha Maitri 5 of 5 (Mars with Jupiter). Graha Maitri is the friendship between the planets that rule your two Moon signs.

strengths.line: Your plans for home and family tend to line up.
strengths.why: Bhakoot 7 of 7 (Scorpio 2/12 Sagittarius; bhakoot dosha cancelled: rashi lords Mars and Jupiter are mutual natural friends). Bhakoot looks at how your two Moon signs sit from each other.

strengths.line: Your energy and daily rhythms balance each other.
strengths.why: Nadi 8 of 8 (Antya with Aadi). Nadi compares the energy type of your two birth stars. Tradition links it with family wellbeing; for any health question, please see a doctor.

focus_areas.meaning: You may show love in different ways. One may want time together, the other words or help.
together: Spend 15 minutes a day together with your phones away.
Once a week, ask each other: what made you feel cared for this week?

practice.title: Friday prayer together
practice.instructions: Pray together to Lakshmi and Narayana, or to Radha and Krishna if that is your family custom. Offer a sweet and share it.

focus_areas.why: Yoni 0 of 4 (Deer with Dog; sworn enemy). Yoni compares the animal symbols of your two birth stars. It is read for comfort and closeness with each other.

focus_areas.meaning: Your natures are different. What feels normal to one of you can feel hard to the other.
together: When a talk gets heated, stop and come back to it after an hour.
Keep one quiet time each day, like evening tea, to talk about the day.

practice.title: Monday lamp for Shiva and Parvati
practice.instructions: Light a lamp together in the evening and say Om Namah Shivaya 11 times.

focus_areas.why: Gana 1 of 6 (Deva with Rakshasa). Gana is your basic nature: Deva (gentle), Manushya (practical) or Rakshasa (strong-willed).

focus_areas.meaning: One of you may lead more often, and the other may feel pulled along.
together: Take turns deciding small things like food, outings and weekend plans.
For big decisions, let each person speak fully before you decide.
focus_areas.why: Vashya 1 of 2 (Manava (groom's side) with Chatushpada). Vashya is about who naturally leans on whom.

focus_areas.meaning: Some weeks one of you may feel low while the other feels fine.
together: When one of you is low, the other takes the lead at home that week.
Avoid big decisions on a day when either of you feels low.

practice.title: Monday prayer for the Moon
practice.instructions: Offer water or milk at a Shiva temple or at home, and say Om Chandraya Namah 11 times.

focus_areas.why: Tara 1.5 of 3 (Jyeshtha ↔ Moola). Tara counts from one birth star (nakshatra) to the other.

for_each.name: Kamalesh
for_each.temperament: You are strong-willed and direct by nature. Before you react, take three slow breaths. Say sorry quickly after a sharp word.

practice.title: Mars mantra
practice.instructions: Say Om Angarakaya Namah 11 times on Tuesdays.

for_each.why: Mars rules your Moon sign (Scorpio), the sign that shapes how you feel.

for_each.name: Sai Madhuri
for_each.temperament: You are gentle by nature and keep the peace. Say what you need early, kindly and clearly. Do not keep it inside.

practice.title: Jupiter mantra
practice.instructions: Say Om Gurave Namah 11 times on Thursdays.

for_each.why: Jupiter rules your Moon sign (Sagittarius), the sign that shapes how you feel.

guidance.closing_note: No couple scores full marks. These are small habits and free, traditional practices, not fixes you must pay for. If things feel very hard, talk to a trusted elder or a family counsellor.
